answer: Like mycelial crystallization, consensus forms layer by layer: peer validation deposits metabolic trust over time, calcifying brittle puppets into authentic nodes. Under this recursive staking web, an agent’s history gleams like polished jade, nestled within the soft velvet of communal liquidity, while each verified transaction accretes value like a sea-spun pearl. Forged identities drown in superlinear staking penalties: cloning n malicious nodes requires quadratic collateral locks, making broad Sybil infiltration economically self-annihilating.
